gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 522.—PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following roads will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Cul-de-sac commencing at its junction with Fa Yuen Street, running in an easterly direction immediately south of and parallel to Soy Street and terminating at K.I.L. 1157, as shown coloured pink on plan R.K. 179 signed by Hon. D.P.W. and dated 18th April, 1951. Proposed Name: YIN CHONG STREET. Chinese Version: 煙廠街.

No. 522.—PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following roads will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Extension of La Salle Road in a Northerly direction and terminating at its junction with Hereford Road as shown coloured pink on plan R.K. 181 signed by Hon. D.P.W. and dated 18th April, 1951. Proposed Name: LA SALLE ROAD. Chinese Version: 喇沙利道.

No. 522.—PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following roads will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Road commencing at its junction with Waterloo Road, running in an easterly direction along the north boundary of N.K.I.L. 3548 and terminating at the extended portion of La Salle Road as shown coloured pink on plan R.K. 182 signed by Hon. D.P.W. and dated 18th April, 1951. Proposed Name: HEREFORD ROAD. Chinese Version: 禧福道.

No. 522.—PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. D.P.W. and dated 18th April, 1951. Proposed Name: CAMBRIDGE ROAD. Chinese Version: 劍橋道.
